ptBrText: Você é mais resistente do que Axe pensava!

sourceText: You look like Axe, only slightly less.
That is a fearsome creature you ride, Disruptor.
Side by side, the Oglodi fight.
The Oglodi shall take this fight.
Warlock brings a book. Axe brings an axe.
Axe is curious. Where did your face go?
Undying, don't order Axe around and we'll get along just fine.
Don't worry, Treant, Axe does not come to chop you.
Witch doctor, our enemies are in need of Axe-amination!
Tinker, eh? War is an Axe-act science!
There can be no battle till Axe is at hand. And Axe is.
ptBrText: Não há batalha até Axe chegar. E Axe chegou.

sourceText: Don't worry, precious Axe. Blink Dagger does not come to chop.
ptBrText: Não se preocupe, precioso Axe. A Adaga de Translocação não veio cortar.

sourceText: Axe does not need this, but no one else shall have it.

ptBrText: Nem só de lâmina vive Axe!

sourceText: You get nothing. Good day, sir!
Axe likes this so much words fail Axe.
Axe is back and ready to whack! And also hack!
Ha ha, the blade of Axe has tasted first blood!
ptBrText: Ha ha, a lâmina de Axe provou o primeiro sangue!

sourceText: Axe will whittle them down one by one.
ptBrText: Axe vai derrubá-los um por um.

sourceText: The Axe's edge will never dull!
Axe is calling it: It's in the bag!
This was in the bag the day Axe was born!

ptBrText: Sua vida na lâmina de Axe!

sourceText: Axe chops you down to size!
ptBrText: Axe corta você até o tamanho certo!

sourceText: Axe warms his blade in your guts!
Twenty hacks from the axe of Axe!
Sheathe my axe in your bowels!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Mwa ha ha ha ha ha!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Bottom is missing according to Axe.
By his blade, Axe earns this purchase.
So many skulls to cleave. So many bodies to throw on the pile.
No business but war. No family but death. No mercy but the grave!

ptBrText: Axe vive para cortar de novo!

sourceText: The Axe's edge is keen again!
ptBrText: O fio de Axe está afiado novamente!

sourceText: Axe is all the reinforcement this army needs!
From the Red Mist, Axe returns!
Axe returns. The war may now continue!
Axe has no time for all this jibber jabber.
Warlock, you should have picked a sharper weapon.
Warlock, who is the smart one now?
Axe hates to till Oglodi but it must be done.
We are blood, true. But most of yours came out.
You were handsome like Axe. Axe doesn't like that.
Too much talking, not enough fighting.
Big words cannot keep you safe from Axe.
The Treant brought much wood for Axe to chop.
Who said Axe fears spiders? Axe wants to know their name.
Taste the Axe. Not this Axe, that axe!
Your name is not Axeworld Destroyer!
What is a tiny razor to a mighty Axe?
You might have been a fancyman in Heaven, but down here you are nothing next to Axe.
Each of Ursa's claws is like a little Axe. Axe reluctantly approves.
Axe has no time for such nonsense!
More things for Axe to chop!
For the Keenfolk, you weren't half bad.
Smallkeens should be scoured from the land!
Axe cut you into more than four.
Axe cut you into more than four. Nine?
Axe cut you into more than four. Twenty?
Axe cut you into more than four. Hundreds?
There is no team in Axe!
